title: 第265章 狙击枪打飞盘
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏莱曼的话音刚落，后院里瞬间安静了下来。

杜坚眉毛猛地跳了一下。

狙击枪打移动靶？

还是两百米外人手抛的飞盘？

这帮家伙玩的也太野了吧！

平时用突击步枪打飞盘就算了，拿拉栓式狙击步枪打，这根本不符合常规战术逻辑！

苏莱曼看着杜坚的表情，咧嘴笑了笑。

“杜队长，觉得不合理？”

他伸手拍了拍放在旁边的的M24。

“也是。”

“狙击手讲究一击不中，一般都会等一个自己最有把握的机会。”

“但是……”

“真实场景里，除非对方没有防备，否则，没人会傻乎乎的一直呆在原地。”

“移动中还能有一定的命中率，这才是最贴近现实的比试。”

“我说的……没错吧？”

杜坚没接话。

他心里很清楚，苏莱曼说的是大实话。

其实，国内也有类似的移动靶训练，甚至有打飞盘的科目。

但那是用专门的抛靶机，从地面向上弹出，轨迹是一条非常标准、容易预测的抛物线。

顶尖的狙击手，在这种科目里命中率能达到百分之五十。

可现在，他们是人手抛飞盘。

这完全是另一回事。

人的力气大小、出手的角度、再加上两百米外的风速影响。

飞盘在空中的轨迹根本无迹可寻。

这完全是在挑战狙击手的反应极限。

杜坚转过头，看向站在身后的疯子。

疯子平时话最少，这会儿脸上的表情也彻底严肃了起来。

他盯着远处的土坡，大拇指无意识地摩挲着枪背带。

察觉到杜坚的视线，疯子迎上他的目光，重重地点了一下头。

但也仅仅是能打，没有必胜的把握。

看到疯子表态，杜坚转回身，下巴微抬。

“行。”

“既然是在巴扎尔甘，那就按你们的规矩来。”

作为大国精锐，骨子里的骄傲不允许他在这个时候退缩。

输赢另说，气势首先不能丢。

“痛快！”

苏莱曼大手一挥。

“塔里克，去拿飞盘！”

站在后面的塔里克应了一声，转身跑向库房。

没过几分钟，他拎着一个塑料筐跑了回来，里面装满了橘红色的塑料飞盘。

这都是平时他们用来训练的玩意儿。

苏莱曼转过头。

“卡姆兰，这场你上。”

听到苏莱曼点名，卡姆兰咧嘴一笑。

As soon as Suleiman finished speaking, the backyard instantly became quiet.

Du Jian's eyebrows jumped suddenly.

Sniper rifle shooting at a moving target?

Or a Frisbee tossed by someone two hundred meters away?

These guys are playing too wildly!

It's okay to use an assault rifle to shoot Frisbees, but using a bolt-action sniper rifle to shoot them doesn't conform to conventional tactical logic at all!

Suleiman looked at Du Jian's expression and grinned.

"Captain Du, do you think it's unreasonable?"

He reached out and patted the M24 lying next to him.

"Same."

"Snipers are very particular about missing a hit. They usually wait for the opportunity they are most confident of."

"But..."

"In a real scene, unless the other party is unprepared, no one will stay in place stupidly."

"You can still have a certain hit rate while moving. This is the most realistic competition."

"What I said...is correct?"

Du Jian didn't answer.

He knew very well that Suleiman was telling the truth.

In fact, there are similar moving target trainings in China, and there are even Frisbee-playing subjects.

But that was using a special target-throwing machine, which was ejected upward from the ground. The trajectory was a very standard and easy-to-predict parabola.

Top snipers can hit fifty percent in this subject.

But now, they throw the Frisbee by hand.

This is something else entirely.

The influence of the person's strength, the angle of the shot, and the wind speed two hundred meters away.

There is no trace of the trajectory of the flying disc in the air.

This completely challenges the sniper's reaction limit.

Du Jian turned his head and looked at the madman standing behind him.

The lunatic usually talks the least, but now his expression became completely serious.

He stared at the dirt slope in the distance, his thumb unconsciously rubbing the gun sling.

Sensing Du Jian's gaze, Madman met his gaze and nodded heavily.

But it is only possible to fight, there is no guarantee of victory.

Seeing the lunatic's statement, Du Jian turned around and raised his chin slightly.

"Okay."

"Since we are in Bazargan, then follow your rules."

As an elite member of a great country, the pride in his bones does not allow him to back down at this time.

Regardless of winning or losing, the momentum must not be lost first.

"Happy!"

Suleiman waved his hand.

"Tariq, go get the Frisbee!"

Tariq, who was standing behind, responded, turned around and ran towards the warehouse.

Within a few minutes, he ran back with a plastic basket filled with orange-red plastic Frisbees.

These are the things they usually use for training.

Suleiman turned his head.

"Kamran, you do this."

Kamran grinned when he heard Suleiman's name.
